g.text: The force method releases one restraint and restores it through compatibility

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Example L=6 m,w=2 kN/m,constant EI. Upward displacement is positive. Load-only displacement is negative; positive flexibility coefficient corresponds to unit upward
redundant. A_y=7.5 kN and external fixed-end reaction couple=9 kN·m counterclockwise. Linear elastic superposition is assumed.
